exceptions.reason: Sub-pixel glyph coverage. Standalone text and bound labels paint at their stored coordinates with the stored wrapped text, the stored width anchoring each line and verticalAlign ignored (evidenced on #152): all three container paths match the official export byte for byte, the SVG document matches under one rasterizer (0 changed pixels, SSIM 1.0), the scene extent and all twelve baselines agree to the last digit, and in the direct PNG every glyph's horizontal placement agrees; only glyph ink differs between the renderer's rasterizer and the browser's canvas, which snaps each line's baseline to the nearest whole pixel where the renderer fills the outlines at the exact fractional baseline (#169; 0.38 px on every Excalifont line here), together with the roughness-0 stroke edges of the rectangle, ellipse and diamond. The same class is recorded on #104, #105, #108, #110 and #153 for the other text-bearing cases.

purpose: Place text by its stored fields as the static export does: three standalone Excalifont elements with autoResize false and a width wider than either stored line carry textAlign left, center and right with verticalAlign top, middle and bottom, the middle and bottom ones in a box taller than their two lines, so the export lays out the stored wrapped text (not a re-wrap of originalText to the width), anchors each line on the stored width, and ignores verticalAlign for standalone text; three roughness-0 containers, a rectangle, an ellipse and a diamond, each carry a bound label whose stored coordinates are where the editor's verticalAlign top, middle and bottom and textAlign left, right and center placed it, so a shape container's label paints at its stored coordinates rather than being re-derived from the container.
